workflow: Find products by category, salt, parameter or configured substitute and surface new launches; preserve product identity.
acceptance: A filtered search returns permitted products, retains selected identity and never presents a medicinal substitute as an autonomous clinical decision.

workflow: Receive, reserve, issue, transfer and adjust quantities through named stock vouchers and inspect the resulting balance.
acceptance: A receipt, issue and approved adjustment reconcile to the same item/location balance with source-document drilldown.

workflow: Allocate goods to warehouse/store/rack, inspect availability and move selected quantities with sending and receiving evidence.
acceptance: A partial transfer shows in-transit and received quantities without counting one quantity in both available stocks.

workflow: Preserve batch identifiers including separators; track manufacture/expiry; allocate quantities automatically, with confirmation or manually; prepare expiry candidates.
acceptance: A split-batch sale retains exact batch identifiers, dates and source quantities; uncertain legacy separator semantics remain flagged for demonstration.

workflow: Preview conversion between item forms or units, confirm ratios/wastage and inspect quantity/cost effects.
acceptance: A reviewed conversion conserves quantities under its recorded conversion ratio and identifies allowed wastage and cost basis.

workflow: Maintain secondary stock records and reconcile them with the relevant main stock or channel records after source semantics are confirmed.
acceptance: A documented customer example identifies what secondary stock means before posting rules are finalized; the requirement cannot be silently replaced with secondary-sales reporting.

workflow: Record goods issued or received on consignment, ownership, custody, sale settlement and unsold returns separately.
acceptance: An unsold consignment return changes custody without inventing an owned-stock purchase or sale.

workflow: Compare barcode counts to recorded stock, investigate shortages and propose sales-based reorders with reviewer approval.
acceptance: A count difference has a reason and approved adjustment; a reorder proposal shows demand, stock and existing commitments.

workflow: Raise indents, compare quotes, approve purchase/sales orders, fulfil partial quantities and convert orders/challans into invoices with shortages visible.
acceptance: Two partial receipts or deliveries cannot consume the same ordered quantity twice; invoice conversion preserves remaining commitments.

workflow: Enter sale/purchase invoices or fast counter/provisional records, review totals and finalize linked account, stock and tax effects.
acceptance: A provisional document clearly shows its permitted effects; finalization posts each business effect once and links all consequences to one source.

workflow: Link returns to sold/purchased batches and original invoices; process breakage/expiry claims and replacement issue/receipt, including return entry within a sale.
acceptance: A previously sold batch is traceable through return and replacement; commercial, stock and tax dispositions remain independently visible.

workflow: Calculate sale/purchase price differences against identified invoices, quantities and previous rates; route tax consequences for review.
acceptance: A price adjustment states the old rate, new rate, quantity and affected invoices without rewriting historical invoice values.

workflow: Apply party/item/company rate and discount policies with precedence, effective dates, limits and permissioned fast rate changes.
acceptance: An override outside the approved limit records authority and reason; recalculation shows the applicable rate and policy version.

workflow: Load bundle formulas, suggested products and group schemes; inspect previous sale/purchase deals before choosing permitted terms.
acceptance: A bundle decomposes into traceable quantities; stacking and free-goods treatment follow a reviewed policy rather than an assumed discount order.

workflow: Compare supplier quotes and purchase histories, including landed-cost assumptions, then record the chosen supplier and reason.
acceptance: A comparison shows equivalent quantity/unit and applicable charges so different pack sizes cannot mislead the buyer.

workflow: Assess credit exposure during order/billing, request a time-limited override and review outstanding commitments before release.
acceptance: An expired temporary limit no longer authorizes new credit, while the approved order history remains visible.

capability: Books, ledgers and item trading accounts
workflow: Maintain customer/supplier account identities and opening balances. Post linked vouchers to ledgers, inspect trial balance/P&L/balance sheet and drill into item trading accounts with valuation evidence.
acceptance: A corrected transaction has traceable account effects and balanced postings; an item margin reconciles to its stated costing basis.

workflow: Inspect outstanding invoices, tag receipts/credits/adjustments, review interest workings and prepare payment-aware collections.
acceptance: A suspected unallocated bank receipt is reviewed before a reminder draft; allocated and remaining amounts reconcile without duplicate collection.

workflow: Record issued/received advance and postdated cheques, reconcile statement lines and inspect supported connected-bank service outcomes.
acceptance: A bank line has a traceable allocation, unresolved state or approved explanation; bank/provider availability stays an explicit dependency.

workflow: Manage counter cash, payment modes and settlement references; close a cashier session and resolve payment discrepancies.
acceptance: A session close reconciles opening cash, collections and payouts; payment-provider success is not inferred from invoice creation.

workflow: Create MIS views, charts and combined management reports with source drilldown and role/company/period scope.
acceptance: A combined view discloses companies, currency/period basis and freshness; totals drill into authorized records and statutory balances remain distinct.

workflow: Assign transactions to cost centres, compare approved budgets and sales/collection targets, and explain variances.
acceptance: A budget variance shows its period, allocation basis and source transactions rather than mixing unrelated targets.

workflow: Invite and manage users; grant viewing, editing and export rights by company, branch, GSTIN and record responsibility.
acceptance: A user assigned to one company cannot retrieve another company through search, export, reports or direct record navigation.

workflow: Staff prepare; designated reviewers approve exceptional stock/account actions and period work; record operator history, freeze and controlled reopen.
acceptance: Changing an approved calculation invalidates affected approval; reopening a frozen period records reason, authority and subsequent review.

workflow: Configure invoices and local-language outputs; generate bank letters, packing slips, cover notes, gate passes, labels and barcodes from reviewed records.
acceptance: An output contains the selected document version and template version with readable local-language content and correct barcode identity.

workflow: Offer touchscreen/multicounter billing, scales, virtual keyboard, item popups, recent reports, side displays and permissioned shortcut equivalents.
acceptance: A counter can complete representative billing with supported browser/device inputs; unresolved F3/F4 semantics are demonstrated before shortcuts are assigned.

workflow: Preview automatic invoice separation and amount/day-based document conversion after exact source criteria and document types are demonstrated.
acceptance: A reviewed example establishes split/conversion rules and links every resulting document to its source; ambiguous vendor labels remain unresolved.

workflow: Draft SMS/email/messaging and calling follow-ups; schedule authorized stock/sales summaries with recipient and delivery visibility.
acceptance: The sender previews recipient, business scope and message before authorized delivery; failed delivery never marks the business task complete.

workflow: Track enquiries and orders, ownership, customer requests, next actions and fulfilment blockers from first contact through delivery.
acceptance: A customer follow-up opens the correct order and owner, preserving earlier commitments and their disposition.

capability: Home delivery and proof of completion
workflow: Assign dispatch/delivery, confirm quantities, collect permitted proof and record failed/partial delivery and related collection.
acceptance: A partially delivered order retains remaining quantities and proof; collection and delivery status are not conflated.

workflow: Create reviewable backups/exports, verify recovery, close the year, carry controlled opening balances and access migrated company records through the browser.
acceptance: A restored/exported example reproduces balances and unresolved cases; backup destination and hosting remain undecided despite legacy cloud/email labels.

workflow: Capture PDF/photo/tabular data, map masters, review control totals and exchange approved records with traceable errors and outcomes.
acceptance: Reimporting the same input does not duplicate posted transactions; each accepted or rejected row has a reason and source link.

workflow: Expose permitted catalogues and ordering/QR discovery in browser flows; accept orders and collaborative trade exchanges under approved access.
acceptance: An incoming order identifies source, customer, accepted prices and fulfilment state; branded service/data access remains a dependency.

workflow: Show the business which optional service bundles and usage entitlements are enabled and which workflows require external service access.
acceptance: An unavailable entitlement is explained before action; Super Pack/Home Edition semantics remain an explicit research question.

capability: Sales force, routes and manufacturer reporting
workflow: Take route/salesperson orders or field invoices in the browser; track targets, commissions, C&F/DMS activity and authorized secondary-sales reporting.
acceptance: A route order links to fulfilment and collections; secondary-sales reports preserve provenance and never imply access to proprietary datasets.

workflow: Capture permitted H1/narcotics sale details and produce reviewed registers; open approved drug/salt reference or helpline resources.
acceptance: A register entry links to sale/prescriber/patient evidence under scoped access; references do not grant prescribing authority.

workflow: Link prescriptions and patient records to dispensing; manage promise orders and authorized refill reminders with outstanding quantities.
acceptance: A partial dispensing preserves remaining quantities and relevant prescription evidence without exposing patient data to unrelated users.

workflow: Record bag counts, variable weights/tare and item-level loading/commission/other expenses during mandi buying and selling.
acceptance: A specimen commodity trade reconciles bags, net weight, expense ownership and reviewed landed-cost/tax treatment.

workflow: Maintain kitty/committee instalments separately from pledged articles, valuations, dues and redemption history.
acceptance: Separate reviewed examples specify instalment and pledge accounting; legal/licensing/interest rules remain prerequisites rather than assumed permissions.

workflow: Record crate/caret issue, return, damage/loss, deposits and party balances after confirming legacy terminology.
acceptance: A party container balance reconciles issued and returned quantities, with deposits and damaged stock separately reviewed.

workflow: Register patient-linked visits, consultation/service charges and relevant pharmacy links once OPD/Reki source behaviour is demonstrated.
acceptance: A reviewed example identifies clinical boundaries and permissions; a service charge does not expose unrelated patient data.

workflow: Maintain style/size/colour/season variants, purchase and sell specific variants and inspect their balances and replenishment needs.
acceptance: A colour/size return restores the correct variant rather than a pooled product balance.

workflow: Track article/hallmark/insurance references, purity/weight/making charges, karigar custody, repairs and old-gold exchanges.
acceptance: A repair or exchange retains article identity, weights and reviewed valuation; insurance/hallmark access and rules remain explicit dependencies.

workflow: Manage tables/order modes, pending KOT/challans, kitchen display, recipe consumption, delivery-marketplace intake and tips/waiter reporting.
acceptance: A changed or cancelled KOT is visible to kitchen and cashier; inventory consumption follows confirmed recipe and cancellation rules.

workflow: Schedule appointments against staff availability, record changes/no-shows and link completed services to billing.
acceptance: A rescheduled booking preserves history and prevents conflicting confirmed assignments under the agreed booking policy.

workflow: Plan materials and production, apply formulation/BOM versions, trace batch consumption/cost and hold or release output with quality evidence.
acceptance: A held batch cannot be selected as released stock; finished quantity and cost trace to the reviewed BOM and actual consumption.

workflow: Maintain employee/attendance/leave/salary inputs, calculate and review payroll and produce permissioned payroll reports.
acceptance: A payroll run identifies input version and review; reimbursement links never expose salary details to ordinary expense reviewers.

workflow: Accrue and redeem approved customer rewards with sale/return links and a transparent balance.
acceptance: A returned sale adjusts rewards under the applicable policy and cannot be redeemed twice.

workflow: Effective-dated registration/regime, filing frequency, turnover history, authorized signatory, declared locations and obligations. Explain why each return or document requirement applies.
acceptance: An applicability change records effective dates and source basis; a workspace retains previous periods under their original registration context.

workflow: HSN/SAC/UQC, taxability, cess and valuation rules, place-of-supply decisions, bill-to/ship-to, exemptions and rate history. Record the basis and reviewer for exceptional classifications.
acceptance: An exceptional place-of-supply or classification decision retains facts, authority and reviewer; later policy changes preserve invoice history.

workflow: Line-level explanation, GSTIN checks with verification date, arithmetic/rounding review, duplicates, party status and tax-inclusive pricing. Preview corrections and preserve original evidence.
acceptance: An invoice explains each tax line and highlights an invalid/unknown check result without claiming a live verification when only imported evidence exists.

workflow: Applicability, validation, registration, original acknowledgement/QR evidence, errors, cancellation eligibility and uncertain-response recovery. Link all attempts to one document.
acceptance: An uncertain response remains unresolved until evidence establishes acceptance or failure; retry cannot create a second registration for the same document.

workflow: E-way applicability, transport/vehicle details, generation, updates, validity/extension checks, consolidation and dispatch readiness. Respect active rules rather than withdrawn announcements.
acceptance: Dispatch readiness distinguishes document validity, movement requirements and vehicle details; an extension or update records applicable eligibility.

workflow: PDF/photo/spreadsheet/manual capture, field provenance, party/item mapping, PO/receipt/service evidence, duplicate controls and quantity/rate/tax variances.
acceptance: Extracted fields remain linked to source evidence; a duplicate expense/purchase cannot be posted a second time merely through another intake channel.

workflow: Books versus 2B/IMS, sales versus IRP/GSTR-1, amendments, prior periods, credit notes and imported documents. Explain proposed matches and isolate unexplained differences.
acceptance: A changed statement or invoice produces an explainable new comparison and preserves the previous run and affected approvals.

workflow: Eligibility at line/amount level; evidence requirements; blocked/common/nonbusiness credit; receipt/payment conditions; claim history; reversals/reclaims; deadline exposure.
acceptance: A matched purchase can remain ineligible; the same credit amount has traceable claim, reversal and reclaim history without double claiming.

workflow: Allowed actions per record/period, consequence preview, no-action exposure, pending deadlines, remarks, actual reversal amounts and acknowledgement/recomputation checks.
acceptance: An action preview shows permitted choices and consequences for this record/period; task completion alone cannot assert portal acknowledgement.

workflow: Dispute bundles, follow-up drafts, evidence exchange, owner assignment and reminders. Commercial payment decisions remain separate from a GST mismatch.
acceptance: A proposed supplier/customer follow-up includes the disputed documents and considers allocated or suspected payments; GST mismatch does not automatically block commercial payment.

workflow: Original-invoice-linked returns; expiry/breakage/destruction; replacements; discounts; commercial notes versus GST adjustments; tax and stock effects reviewed separately.
acceptance: An expiry return after a rate change links original invoice, batch, commercial note and reviewed tax treatment separately.

workflow: Classified obligations, self-documentation where applicable, tax liability/payment evidence and separately reviewed ITC. Explain applicability rather than treating every unregistered purchase as RCM.
acceptance: An unregistered purchase is not automatically treated as RCM; applicable liability and any separately reviewed credit carry evidence.

workflow: Period checklist, GSTR-1/IFF/1A and 3B preparation, other applicable forms, variance bridge, approvals, export/upload/signing status, official acknowledgements and locked filed snapshots.
acceptance: Changing an approved return pack requires affected re-review; generated, uploaded, signed and officially filed states remain distinct.

workflow: Estimated versus approved liabilities, credit/cash ledger evidence, allocation, payment references, interest/late-fee review and period-specific obligations. Bank payment is not automatically proof of return filing.
acceptance: Estimated liability, approved liability, payment and official ledger evidence are distinct; a bank receipt never automatically marks a return filed.

workflow: Create/select legal companies, GST registrations and branches; maintain independent company books and scoped management views. Same-registration movement, distinct-person supply and ISD workflows remain separate. Pair sending/receiving records and reconcile interbranch discrepancies without concealing them in group totals.
acceptance: A same-GSTIN transfer, distinct-person supply and ISD allocation produce distinct reviewed records; independent company books and GSTIN records remain traceable in group totals.

workflow: BoE/customs evidence, import credit matching, export/SEZ applicability, LUT/bond evidence where relevant and refund dossier/status. Domestic matching rules cannot be blindly reused.
acceptance: Import/export/SEZ treatment uses relevant customs/export evidence; domestic purchase matching cannot silently decide imported-credit eligibility.

workflow: Composition, QRMP and relevant TDS/TCS/ISD cases with registration-specific forms, rights and calculations. Keep GST deductions distinct from income-tax deductions.
acceptance: An obligation is selected for its registration and effective regime; GST TDS/TCS never collapses into income-tax deduction handling.

workflow: GSTR-9/9C where applicable, financial-year versus return-period reconciliation, historic claims/reversals, migration control totals and unresolved opening cases.
acceptance: Migration control totals reconcile stock, accounts and historical credit cases; annual reconciliations expose period differences rather than erasing them.

workflow: Notice intake, response dates, issue-to-transaction links, evidence bundles, response versions and authorized submission/acknowledgement. No fabricated legal response or automatic admission.
acceptance: A notice case links issues to evidence and versioned response drafts; only authorized submissions can receive official acknowledgement status.

workflow: Source/effective-date/supersession tracking, rate/MRP transition previews, impact assessment, reviewer sign-off and period-specific audit evidence.
acceptance: A rate/policy revision previews open documents and representative historical cases, records accountant sign-off and leaves historical calculations intact.

workflow: Attribute exclusive/common use, document allocation bases, prepare periodic reversal and applicable annual adjustment, track capital-goods history and preserve reviewer-approved calculations.
acceptance: Common-credit allocations and capital-goods adjustments show basis, periods, asset use and approved workings.

workflow: Principal/job-worker roles, challans, goods sent and partially returned, direct dispatch, scrap/waste, applicable statutory clocks and reporting, and overdue-case assessment.
acceptance: Partial job-work returns preserve principal-owned quantities, challans, remaining deadlines and separate scrap/direct-dispatch treatment.

workflow: Receipt/payment evidence, receipt/refund vouchers where applicable, goods/services tax assessment, allocation to invoices, cancellation/refund, unadjusted balances and period reporting.
acceptance: Advance allocation connects receipt/payment, invoice and refund without double recognition and retains reviewed goods/services tax treatment.

workflow: Explicit client/company/GSTIN access, assigned preparations, versioned review packs, reviewer reassignment, approval independence policy, client handover and access revocation.
acceptance: A CA sees only authorized client/GSTIN/period work, receives a versioned review pack and loses access on revocation while handover evidence remains available.

workflow: Invite a user into explicit business scopes; enroll permitted authentication, recover access, inspect/revoke sessions and offboard the account.
acceptance: Revoking a user or session prevents further protected actions; recovery cannot expand company or reviewer rights.

workflow: Create period-specific work from approved task/checklist templates; assign preparer/reviewer, dependencies and internal targets; attach a statutory due date and its source basis only where applicable; manage reassignment, recurrence and reopening.
acceptance: One active obligation creates one period task; overlapping engagements are flagged; closing requires evidence and no duplicate tasks arise on rerun.

workflow: Group notifications by document/case and scope; show owner, amount, due date, blocker and permitted action; acknowledge, snooze or escalate under an approved policy.
acceptance: Ten changes on one case form a coherent thread; acknowledgement does not approve the transaction or complete the obligation.

workflow: Show preparation/review activity, surface new changes, compare conflicting edits and recheck document version before posting or approval.
acceptance: A stale browser cannot silently overwrite a newer review or post an obsolete approval; user sees changed fields and permitted reload/merge choices.

workflow: Store each source file with business scope, period, provenance and version; link it to records/cases; detect duplicates and missing evidence; search and export authorized dossiers.
acceptance: Replacing a file creates a version; a historical approval still opens the precise evidence version reviewed; an export reveals no unauthorized company files.

capability: Document drafts, templates and consent records
workflow: Draft supplier letters, review queries, management declarations, engagement scopes and notice working responses; compare versions, review exports and preserve signed/accepted copies and consent.
acceptance: A signed/accepted copy refers to one immutable draft version and scope; editing produces a new draft and requires renewed acceptance where relevant.

workflow: Agree services, client companies/GSTINs, periods, preparers and reviewer rights; turn accepted engagement scope into applicable work and create a controlled handover on closure.
acceptance: An amended engagement cannot inherit acceptance for a different company or period; overlapping work and revocation are visible.

capability: Shared client view and audience-aware discussion
workflow: Offer business-visible status and evidence requests alongside separate internal accountant notes; preserve discussion context and revoke client access with a handover pack.
acceptance: An internal review comment is absent from client views/exports unless deliberately shared; each request links its client, period and missing evidence.

workflow: Record invoice owner, company GSTIN, supplier, purpose/cost centre, paid-by party and payment proof; review staff claims, advances and reimbursements with purchase/ITC evidence.
acceptance: One bill uploaded by both employee and purchasing links to one expense; company payment and employee reimbursement cannot both settle the same payable unnoticed.

workflow: Show extraction provenance/confidence; suggest mappings, match candidates and drafts; expose each step, evidence, changed assumptions, failures and handoff before consequential actions.
acceptance: A preparation run stops for missing facts or changed scope and hands off unresolved decisions; it cannot autonomously elect tax treatment, sign, file or send messages.

capability: Saved work queues, imports and controlled bulk actions
workflow: Save authorized filters; preview selected/blocked records, mappings, duplicates and control totals; perform permitted imports or bulk work with per-row outcomes and correction files.
acceptance: A bulk action previews its exact scope, skips protected rows with reasons and cannot approve hidden cases; retries identify existing accepted rows.

capability: Review scenarios, reruns and audit evidence
workflow: Maintain representative business scenarios for tax/rate changes; compare before/after results, rerun reconciliation/review with diffs, preserve evidence and show recurring causes/backlog.
acceptance: A changed rule or statement shows affected cases and approvals; the previous run and filed snapshot remain intact and operational indicators have explicit definitions.

workflow: Version approved owner/reviewer assignments, thresholds, evidence requirements, escalation and exception reasons; preview affected open work before activating the policy.
acceptance: A revised policy shows affected unfinished work; it cannot remove mandatory controls or retroactively rewrite completed approvals.
